status: PRE-REGISTRATION of the NHL game-level DEV screen phase0/pv_nhl_screen.py. Written before that script existed and before any log-loss for arms A1-A3 was computed.
harness: phase0/nhl_depth_eval.py Ctx/Folds: DEV regular season, LOSO over 2011-12..2017-18, n=7,929; shipped blend [elo_logit(k=8,ha=30,reg=0.30), rest_diff, b2b_home, b2b_away, xg_diff(6.0,0.15,0.30)], logistic C=1e6

features.lv: tonight's dressed-skater lineup value (composite goals/60 x expected minutes / 60 summed over the dressed skaters), goals/game, walk-forward
features.gv: tonight's confirmed starting goalie's value (1v1 saving rating x league xGA/team-game x walk-forward weight), goals saved/game vs the average goalie, walk-forward
features.audit: same file (hash-identical) passed data/pv_nhl_compose_audit.json A1-A4 (target permutation, truncation, input perturbation, same-game-fact scramble) at three cutoffs

arms.A1 PRIMARY: Goalie INSIDE the W/L Elo, MLB starter-adjustment style: E = (R_h + g*gv_h + 30) - (R_a + g*gv_a), p = 1/(1+10^(-E/400)), R_h += 8(y-p), R_a -= 8(y-p), season regress 0.30; the team rating therefore learns strength NET of its starting goalie. Blend column 1 = logit(p); rest_diff, b2b_home, b2b_away, xg_diff (shipped) kept; plus (lv_home - lv_away) as a feature. g nested over {0,60,120,180,240} Elo per goal/game with bt_nhl_nhl_gmar.nested (inner pair-loss selection, ties to the first grid value); the bar is judged on the NESTED prediction only.
arms.A2: Lineup value REPLACES the xG team rating: [shipped elo_logit, rest_diff, b2b_home, b2b_away, (lv_home - lv_away)]; xg_diff removed. No hyperparameter.
arms.A3: A1 + A2: goalie-inside Elo column (g nested over the same grid) + rest_diff, b2b_home, b2b_away + (lv_home - lv_away); xg_diff removed.

bar: documents/breakthrough_program_prereg_2026_09_24.md: A1 nested gain vs the shipped blend >= +0.00100 nats AND 10,000-draw paired game bootstrap (seed 7) 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND every sanity check passes AND every walk-forward check passes. A2 and A3 are pre-declared secondary arms and cannot be promoted in place of A1 by this screen.
statistics: bt_nhl_nhl_gmar.arm_stats unmodified: paired per-game log-loss difference vs p0 = LOSO shipped blend; 10k bootstrap seed 7; harness 4k bootstrap seed 7; per-season fold deltas; late-DEV readout on seasons 2015-16..2017-18 with its own 10k CI. Identical eval mask (sha1 recorded) for every arm.

sanity.S1: shipped DEV LOSO LL reproduces 0.672398 with n=7,929
sanity.S3: the inside-Elo at g=0 equals nhl_depth_eval.run_elo_arr(8,30,0.30) bitwise over all DEV games, and the A1 g=0 design equals [shipped blend, lv diff]
sanity.S4: every eval game has lv and gv; the feature file's home codes (TEAM_FIX) equal the harness's
sanity.S5: the A1 g=0 cell (shipped blend + lv diff) reproduces pv_nhl_compose_screen.json 'C3 lv' gain_exact to 1e-9 (feature-join check)

walk_forward.W1: feature file sha256 equals the audited file
walk_forward.W2: inside-Elo perturbation at cutoffs 2013-02-15, 2015-01-15, 2017-02-01: permute y among games on/after the cutoff and replace gv with noise there; for every g the pre-cutoff probabilities must be bitwise identical and some post-cutoff probability must change
walk_forward.W3: identical eval mask and y hash across arms; no NaN in any masked design

diagnostics_not_arms.D1 serving: A1 with tonight's lv and gv replaced by the team's previous-10-game means (lv - lv_dev, gv - gv_dev; NaN at a team's first game -> 0), g nested the same way. Measures what survives WITHOUT day-of lineup and starter information. Not eligible for the bar.
diagnostics_not_arms.D2: per-g cell LOSO LL (optimistic, single-cell, reported only)
diagnostics_not_arms.D3: paired A3-vs-A1 and A2-vs-(blend+lv) contrasts; descriptive all-DEV coefficients

disclosure: Read before this pre-registration: data/pv_nhl_compose_screen.json (C1 blend+lv+gv +0.00159; C3 blend+lv +0.00140; C7 (lv+gv) inside the Elo, g nested over {0,60,120,180,240}, picks 180/240, +0.00131) and data/bt_nhl_gmar.json (round-1 GSAx-goalie inside the Elo, +0.00020 n.s.). The three arms were specified by the task, not chosen after those results; the g grid is copied from C7. The component hyperparameters and composite weights were chosen on DEV by their owners (walk-forward weights).
day_of_information: lv needs tonight's dressed skaters (official game roster, public before puck drop); gv needs tonight's confirmed starting goalie (first goalie to face a shot; confirmed at warmups, usually projected from the morning skate). Neither is known when the opening line is posted.
